_source: Derived from the SPIN simulator (spins) model in the CCAG benchmark set (github.com/GIST-NJU/CCAG, MIT license), originally from Cohen, Dwyer & Shi, IEEE TSE 34 (2008). Projection onto the 9 parameters that appear in its 13 constraints. NOT the benchmark itself.
_note: Parameters keep their original CASA positions (P0..P17); the 9 omitted parameters (P5..P11, P16, P17) are unconstrained. Valid configurations: 978 here, 978*2048 = 2,002,944 in the full model.
